title: Passkey Vault
description: The password vault the Jupyter server keeps, unlocked with a passkey, an unlock password or the recovery passphrase

unlockMinutes.title: Unlock duration (minutes)
unlockMinutes.description: How long the vault stays unlocked after an unlock, for every client: the panel, the CLI and the Python API

passwordMinLength.title: Shortest unlock password (characters)
passwordMinLength.description: The fewest characters the vault accepts when an unlock password is set. A copy of the vault file can be attacked by guessing this password, so a longer one protects the file better

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Which sidebar holds the vault panel
